   OBJECTIONS TO SOAH ORDER NO. 30 (INDEX NO 5835) BY INTERVENORS
          JEFF AND TOY JOYCE (NOW IDENTIFIED AS PARTY 64)

       Intervenors, Jeff Joyce and Toy Joyce (Index No. 2116) (now identified as Party 64),

file these objections to SOAH Order No. 30 Attachments A and B as directed by Judge Brite

at the June 5, 2026 pretrial hearing.

   1. It appears that Intervenors are designated as party number 64 on Attachment A and

       B.

   2. Objection to Attachment A to the extent it shows Jeff Joyce at party 64, but only as a

       witness. Intervenors should be shown in the first column as intervenors and should

       not reflect that Jeff Joyce is only a witness for Intervenor 62, Mewhinney Family.

   3. Objection to Attachment A to the extent the form document does not accurately line

       up with Witness Jeff Joyce. Jeff Joyce witness should reflect Exhibits 1, 2 and 3 which

       were timely submitted. It appears that Attachment A should also reflect that Jeff

       Joyce’s timely filed direct testimony is now identified as Exhibit 4.

   4. Objection to Attachment B to the extent it does not reflect Toy Joyce as an Intervernor
        jointly with Jeff Joyce.

   5. Objection to Attachment B to the extent it inaccurately identifies the Link Intervenors

       are Affected by in the far right column. Intervenors’ original intervention (Index number

       2116) identifies Link E11 as the link which affects them. Attachment B should be

       correct to properly reflect the intervention addresses Link E11.

                                                              Respectfully submitted,
